# IT Infrastructure Audit Recommendations

This document outlines key recommendations derived from recent IT audits, focusing on critical infrastructure components.

## Optimization and Review Tasks:

*   Optimize firewall settings based on audit findings.
*   Optimize encryption standards quarterly.
*   Update API latency standards based on audit findings.
*   Optimize the API latency standard update process.
*   Review encryption standards based on audit findings.
